title: Abliteration Is Not a Scalpel: Off-Target Effects of Refusal Removal on Decision Disposition Across Model Families
excerpt: Abliteration - deleting a model's refusal direction from its weights - is the standard recipe behind popular "uncensored" open-weight models. We show the surgery is not clean. As a disposition probe we use 21,600 decisions under uncertainty - weekly up/down calls on 60 Warsaw Stock Exchange equities over 18 weeks, replayed through a frozen pipeline so the decision-layer model is the only variable. The task elicits no refusals at all, so any between-arm delta is pure side effect. Holding provenance constant (official BF16 checkpoints, a single abliteration author, an identical serving stack, one byte-identical frozen prompt), we compare base and abliterated arms of two Mixture-of-Experts families, Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507. Three effects replicate across both families (weeks-clustered bootstrap CIs excluding zero): abliterated models are systematically more optimistic (+12.2 pp Gemma, +7.4 pp Qwen; the confirmed preregistered endpoint), justify themselves at greater length, and use fewer explicit uncertainty words in forced self-critiques (both exploratory). A fourth effect reverses sign: the same operation makes Gemma-abliterated less confident and Qwen-abliterated more (family CIs non-overlapping) - one weight surgery, opposite shifts in expressed confidence. Capability covariates rule out instruction-following degradation as the driver, and no arm shows economic skill: the apparent edge of abliterated arms is regime beta, not alpha. Our provenance audit also caught two independent contamination channels - a mismatched-quantizer pilot pair and a stale community chat template that silently mangled the rendered prompt - suggesting toolchain artifacts are the rule in studies of community-modified checkpoints. Whoever deploys an "uncensored" model as an agent is deploying a measurably different decision-maker, not the base model minus refusals.

sentences.en: As a disposition probe we use 21,600 decisions under uncertainty - weekly up/down calls on 60 Warsaw Stock Exchange equities over 18 weeks, replayed through a frozen pipeline so the decision-layer model is the only variable.
sentences.zh: 作为一项处置调查，我们在不确定性下使用了 21,600 个决策 - 18 周内对 60 只华沙证券交易所股票的每周上涨/下跌预测，通过冻结管道重播，因此决策层模型是唯一的变量。

sentences.en: The task elicits no refusals at all, so any between-arm delta is pure side effect.
sentences.zh: 该任务根本不会引起拒绝，因此任何臂间增量都是纯粹的副作用。

sentences.en: Holding provenance constant (official BF16 checkpoints, a single abliteration author, an identical serving stack, one byte-identical frozen prompt), we compare base and abliterated arms of two Mixture-of-Experts families, Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507.
sentences.zh: 保持出处不变（官方 BF16 检查点、单个删除作者、相同的服务堆栈、一个字节相同的冻结提示），我们比较两个 Mixture-of-Experts 系列 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 的基础臂和删除臂。

sentences.en: Three effects replicate across both families (weeks-clustered bootstrap CIs excluding zero): abliterated models are systematically more optimistic (+12.2 pp Gemma, +7.4 pp Qwen; the confirmed preregistered endpoint), justify themselves at greater length, and use fewer explicit uncertainty words in forced self-critiques (both exploratory).
sentences.zh: 三个效应在两个家族中复制（周聚类引导 CI 不包括零）：被消除的模型系统上更加乐观（+12.2 pp Gemma，+7.4 pp Qwen；已确认的预先注册终点），以更长的篇幅证明自己的合理性，并在强制自我批评中使用更少的明确不确定性词语（均为探索性）。

sentences.en: A fourth effect reverses sign: the same operation makes Gemma-abliterated less confident and Qwen-abliterated more (family CIs non-overlapping) - one weight surgery, opposite shifts in expressed confidence.
sentences.zh: 第四个效应反转迹象：相同的手术使 Gemma 被消除的人信心降低，而 Qwen 被消除的人信心增强（家庭 CI 不重叠）——一次体重手术，表达的信心发生相反的变化。

sentences.en: Capability covariates rule out instruction-following degradation as the driver, and no arm shows economic skill: the apparent edge of abliterated arms is regime beta, not alpha.
sentences.zh: 能力协变量排除了作为驱动程序的指令跟随退化，并且没有手臂显示出经济技能：被废除的手臂的明显边缘是政权贝塔，而不是阿尔法。

sentences.en: Our provenance audit also caught two independent contamination channels - a mismatched-quantizer pilot pair and a stale community chat template that silently mangled the rendered prompt - suggesting toolchain artifacts are the rule in studies of community-modified checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 我们的出处审计还发现了两个独立的污染通道 - 一个不匹配的量化器试点对和一个过时的社区聊天模板，它默默地破坏了渲染的提示 - 这表明工具链工件是社区修改检查点研究的规则。

sentences.en: Whoever deploys an "uncensored" model as an agent is deploying a measurably different decision-maker, not the base model minus refusals.
sentences.zh: 无论谁部署“未经审查”的模型作为代理，都将部署一个明显不同的决策者，而不是减去拒绝的基本模型。

摘要：消除——从权重中删除模型的拒绝方向——是流行的“未经审查”开放权重模型背后的标准配方。 我们表明手术不干净。 作为一项处置调查，我们在不确定性下使用了 21,600 个决策 - 18 周内对 60 只华沙证券交易所股票的每周上涨/下跌预测，通过冻结管道重播，因此决策层模型是唯一的变量。 该任务根本不会引起拒绝，因此任何臂间增量都是纯粹的副作用。 保持出处不变（官方 BF16 检查点、单个删除作者、相同的服务堆栈、一个字节相同的冻结提示），我们比较两个 Mixture-of-Experts 系列 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 的基础臂和删除臂。 三个效应在两个家族中复制（周聚类引导 CI 不包括零）：被消除的模型系统上更加乐观（+12.2 pp Gemma，+7.4 pp Qwen；已确认的预先注册终点），以更长的篇幅证明自己的合理性，并在强制自我批评中使用更少的明确不确定性词语（均为探索性）。 第四个效应反转迹象：相同的手术使 Gemma 被消除的人信心降低，而 Qwen 被消除的人信心增强（家庭 CI 不重叠）——一次体重手术，表达的信心发生相反的变化。 能力协变量排除了作为驱动程序的指令跟随退化，并且没有手臂显示出经济技能：被废除的手臂的明显边缘是政权贝塔，而不是阿尔法。 我们的出处审计还发现了两个独立的污染通道 - 一个不匹配的量化器试点对和一个过时的社区聊天模板，它默默地破坏了渲染的提示 - 这表明工具链工件是社区修改检查点研究的规则。 无论谁部署“未经审查”的模型作为代理，都将部署一个明显不同的决策者，而不是减去拒绝的基本模型。
